# Build Your Own AI Bot (RAG for non-technical people) — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Bot answering from 1 document; curated folder

*Module 1: Day 1 — Understanding · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_bot_from_one_document.py`): Pick ONE document from your own work. Ask five questions it answers and two it does not. Tick: answered correctly / cited / refused correctly.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Bot on your own 20 documents

*Module 2: Day 2 — Building the library · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_build_the_library.py`): Audit your own 20-document folder with this script (put .md/.txt files in the workshop sample_docs folder). Read five of your chunks aloud: would a new colleague understand each one alone?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — One-change-at-a-time tuning with before/after score

*Module 3: Day 3 — Finding the right page · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_find_the_right_page.py`): In your no-code tool make ONE change (hybrid on, then reranker on, then top-k). Record before/after on your ten questions in the scoring grid.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Finished bot + test sheet + cost estimate

*Module 4: Day 4 — Answering well and going live · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_answer_well_go_live.py`): Complete the launch checklist for your own bot. Anything unticked is your homework before you show it to a customer.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
